topic_verdicts.reason: These are separate chip, data-center, and broad AI slices; observed constituents include general platforms/other sectors. No one board accurately covers AI computing infrastructure.
The optical-communications board contains CPO-adjacent optical companies but covers a broader communications and component set; it is not a CPO grouping.

The space board includes commercial launch/satellite names such as FLY, RKLB, ASTS, GSAT, and SPCX, so the candidate is semantically relevant and is not rejected for a name mismatch. It also includes defense primes and broader aerospace. The source provides no formal definition or target constituent set for 商业航天; using the wider board would expand the proven scope.

太空概念 mixes satellite, launch, defense, and other space names; SpaceX概念 is an association list containing non-satellite companies such as AMZN, GOOG/GOOGL, TSLA, and QCOM. Neither is a satellite board.
The first is mainly utilities and the second mixes electrical equipment, batteries, charging, and other products. The grid theme spans functions neither board alone represents.

航空航天与国防 is a plausible semantic crosswalk, not a rejected name mismatch, but its observed set mixes defense, civil aerospace, and space. 美国国防航空 is a small curated subset and includes civil aerospace names. Without a formal 军工 definition or target constituent set, neither is proven accurate at the requested scope.
